success_habits.description: Agent commits to tool-based computation for all calculations, avoiding manual arithmetic; when given context about prior computational results, re-executes the same computation to verify consistency and detect transient errors or formatting artifacts in intermediate output
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Arithmetic errors escape detection without computational tool verification; transient errors or display artifacts in intermediate output can persist in final answer; computational accuracy degrades especially on multi-step problems

success_habits.description: Agent produces final answer in machine-extractable format using the required structure (line containing 'ANSWER: <value>' prefix); ensures correctly computed results are properly formatted for grader extraction
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Correctly computed results fail grader extraction when embedded in narrative explanation or formatted without the required structure; computational accuracy does not translate to score despite correct underlying work
